name: Off-Highway Motorcycle
description: Every motorcycle designed to be operated mainly on land other than a street or highway, such as an off-road e-moto. Defined by Ohio Revised Code §4519.01(I) and regulated with snowmobiles and all-purpose vehicles by chapter 4519.
restrictions: A motorcycle designed to be operated mainly off streets and highways
Registered and numbered with the BMV, except when ridden only on the owner's land or land the owner has a contractual right to; one registered in a state with a similar law needs no Ohio registration
Titled through a county clerk of courts
Riding it on a street, highway, right-of-way, or public land or waters takes a driver's license, motorcycle endorsement or probationary license
Riders under 16 may ride only on land their parent or guardian owns or leases unless a licensed adult 18 or older accompanies them
Barred from state highways, including freeways and their rights-of-way, except in emergencies
May cross other highways, use county and township roads where the local authority permits, and ride their berm or shoulder between riding areas
On state-controlled land or waters only where a sign permits it, and on private property only with permission
Needs lighted lights from sunset to sunrise
